PProfile.Safety.Desc:
Set your boundary for romantic dialogues.
- Unrestricted: Flirtations allowed with anyone.
- Relaxed: Casual banter if context fits.
- Hearts Matter: Subtle romance only at high friendship.
- Committed Only: Exclusively with date/spouse.

configRespectAuthorConsentTooltip: Enabled by default. Respects third-party mod authors' permitAiUse declarations. When disabled, AI dialogue is enabled for all custom NPCs.
logPermitAiUseBypassed: [PermitAiUse] User configuration has disabled permitAiUse restrictions. AI dialogue is enabled for all NPCs.
logPermitAiUseBlocked: [PermitAiUse] Detected {{count}} content pack(s) without author AI approval. Respecting author preferences; corresponding NPCs will keep vanilla dialogue.
logPermitAiUseHint: [PermitAiUse] You can change [Respect Modder AI Consent] at any time in the Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM).
configEnableSpouseScheduleTooltip: Allows married spouses to have dynamic daily schedules, wander the farm, and visit locations around town.
configEnableDateSystemTooltip: Allows scheduling dates and romantic outings with eligible NPCs. Currently experimental and disabled by default.
